{{Recipe summary
| Category = Duck recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of China|Cuisine of China]]

This is a recipe for '''Cantonese roast duck or goose''' (燒鴨\燒鵝).

== Ingredients ==
__NOTOC__
=== Marinade ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] light [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 Tbsp dark soy sauce (optional, can use light soy sauce instead)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (450 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) of white [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]], [[Cookbook:Sherry|sherry]], or Chinese cooking wine
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Five Spice Powder|Chinese five spice powder]]

=== Glaze ===
* 2 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Hoisin Sauce|Hoisin sauce]]
* 2 Tbsp dark soy sauce

=== Duck ===

* 3–6 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (1.3–2.6 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) whole [[Cookbook:Duck|duck]] or [[Cookbook:Goose|goose]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]] or 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]

== Procedure ==

=== Preparation ===
# Mix all marinade ingredients together.
# Mix all glaze ingredients together.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the marinade mixture all over the duck, inside and outside.
# Brush some glaze mixture inside the duck cavity.
# Sit duck breast-up on a rack in an open container.
# Put in the refrigerator to chill overnight.

=== Cooking ===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 450°F (220°C)
# Put ½–1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 cm) of water in a roasting pan—this catches the grease that comes out from the duck while roasting and prevents it from smoking.
# Place green onions inside the duck cavity.
# Place the duck on a roasting rack in the roasting pan. [[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the duck for 15 minutes.
# Turn the duck breast-up, and roast for another 15 minutes.
# Turn oven heat to 375°F (190°C), and roast the duck until the internal temperature reaches a minimum of 180°F (test between the thigh, the thickest part of the duck/goose, being careful not to touch the bone)
# Brush the duck with glaze, turn oven up to 450°F (200°C), and roast again for about 10 minutes.
# Carve and serve!
